text.p: These were the headlines on Estonian Kuku radio at Noon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Tallinn-Helsinki railway tunnel association meet in Helsiniki to familarise themselves with a project that could cost eight billion Finnish marks or 21.5 million Estonian kroons.
- On Thursday morning, 'Severuni' a 24 metre Estonian boat ran aground between Osmussaare and Pakri islands in local waters. The boat was on route from Tallinn to Bornholm.
